1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

4. Issue notice.
Mr. Sanjeev Bhandari, learned ASC accepts notice on behalf of State.

In the meantime, the concerned District Judge, who also happens to be the chairman of the Witness Protection Committee, before whom an application for protection will be moved by the petitioner herein, is requested to ensure that the same is heard expeditiously and is disposed of in accordance with law.
